text: Brazil's Ministry of Labour added BYD to its registry of employers that subjected workers to conditions analogous to slavery, after 163 workers were rescued from slave-like labour at BYD's Camaçari factory site; labour prosecutors are suing BYD over the site.
short: Brazil's Labour Ministry put BYD on its slavery-like-conditions registry (2026).

source.name: Agencia Brasil: Chinese carmaker BYD added to Brazil's forced labor list
source.quote: Among the names included is Chinese automaker BYD

additionalSources.name: BBC News: Brazil sues China carmaker BYD over 'slave-like' conditions
additionalSources.quote: Brazilian prosecutors are suing Chinese electric vehicle (EV) giant BYD and two of its contractors
